title: Bíblia Livre (Portuguese Bible, full Old and New Testament, one verse per line), plain-text export in scrollmapper/bible_databases
period: modern (21st-century Portuguese translation); a distant proxy for medieval Galician-Portuguese
notes: License stated as 'Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Brazil' in the source README at https://github.com/scrollmapper/bible_databases/blob/59b18c5af5845728c275d5b7178ad0d024172b1f/sources/pt/PorBLivre/README.md (the text is the CrossWire SWORD module PorBLivre; translator Diego Santos, Bíblia Livre project). The url pins a fixed commit, so the bytes do not change. 4,110,053 bytes; one verse per line as '[c:v] text' with '### Book' headings in English (66 short headings, negligible). vs/refcorpus.normalize(..., 'portuguese') gives 3,660,618 characters. Modern Portuguese, not the 13th-15th-century Galician-Portuguese Cheshire's proposal leans on: it gives the Ibero-Romance west measured power on the grid now; a period cancioneiro or chronicle text should replace it when one is found in a single open file.
